notes.title: Quality of Life Update!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33322639/24469b978a53d7769eeb5ed5475afe34775e6695.gif"]Patch Notes:
[olist]
The top left of the HUD now has an instant night button

Holding left click with the sword out, will now create a continuous whirlwind.

Player health per level increase to 50 from 10.

Added a settings menu for audio and video settings

Engine has been upgraded to Unity 6
[/olist]
Thanks,
Rat Wrath Team

notes.title: Quality of Life Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33322639/ff63ea1b95d83ac35b9146798ddc1597df86fbac.gif"]Fortified Swiss is getting a much needed update!

Thanks,
